routes.label: Compute the decimal quotient, then multiply by 100

question: Which is the result of \(6 \div 20 \times 100\)?
solution:
Multiplication and division have equal priority, so calculate from left to right:
\[
6 \div 20 \times 100 = 0.3 \times 100 = 30.
\]
6 is \(30\%\) of 20. The result is \(30\), choice D.
